contents.support: Supports the declared first-companion orientation; local definitions state the fixed block convention.

contents.support: Supports the finite recovery context; local block equations prove both directions and the infinity branch.

contents.support: Provides the quadratic scaled-residual treatment; the local proof derives the arbitrary-grade weighted Frobenius minimum directly.

contents.support: Supports the caveat; the local lemma provides the exact block residual transfer and a fixed-polynomial unscaled-residual witness.
